id./param/scenario/cs/b_010_cs_070.pack|cs_: "...How curious. Even after seeing such ruin, the light in your eyes has not gone out.
"{var:1}, so many calamities have struck you!
"Yet you broke them time and again, and even amid that destruction, you live!
"Perhaps Yggdrasil is telling us you are still fated to fight Mordegon.
"Luminary {var:1}, kindle the flame of hope to bring light to the world again.
"The flame of hope is with your companions.
"Where their flame shines, the right path will be shown to you.
"Hee hee. Mordegon is impatient. He won't even let me say farewell...
"Look ahead. Do not look back. A Luminary is...
"...one who never gives up, to the very end!
...People of the undersea kingdom, your lives are forfeit to the Lord of Shadows!
